strategy.angle: Industrial shift from experimental AI to hyper-efficient production infrastructure.

draft.hook: The AI hype experiment is officially over; we have entered the era of the 'gigascale' balance sheet.
draft.body: NVIDIA starting high-volume production of the Vera Rubin NVL72 isn’t just about raw compute power—it’s a shot across the bow for anyone treating AI as a side project. We are moving from the 'build at any cost' phase to a brutal stage defined by power efficiency and token price optimization. When infrastructure becomes a primary cost lever, the competitive advantage shifts to those who can operationalize AI without ballooning their energy overhead. At Amplify Intelligence, we’re seeing that Houston’s core industries—specifically energy and logistics—are uniquely positioned to win here if they stop testing and start industrializing. How does this impact your bottom line? It forces a transition where inference costs become the defining metric for ROI. If your cost per token exceeds your margin threshold, you are effectively subsidizing your AI rather than scaling it.
draft.closing: The winners of this next chapter won't be those with the most data, but those with the deepest, most efficient pipelines.
draft.cta: If you are still waiting for 'better' models before integrating, you are missing the internal efficiency shift happening right now. DM me to discuss how to audit your AI infra for true production readiness.
